text: Listen to the whisper of the body so as not to hear its scream. The body always warns about problems in advance—with slight fatigue, a nagging pain, discomfort. If you ignore this whisper, it will turn into a scream—into illness. Develop sensitivity to subtle sensations and react to them immediately. How should you react? Since we are talking about signals of the body, the reaction should first of all be at the level of the body. Something has tightened in your abdomen? Do several full-amplitude inhales and exhales in a half-bridge. Choose obvious solutions. Further, the thread may lead to psychological or behavioral correction. It too is obvious in most cases, but going against supposedly “one’s own nature” is significantly harder than responding at the level of the body.
